Date: 2027-06-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Annual prepay — invoicing cadence & VAT routing

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to move forward on a 12-month prepay (committed spend) for our US and UK entities, but Procurement has two asks before we can issue a PO:

1) Can Redwood split the annual invoice into quarterly tranches on your side and provide a drawdown schedule so our accounting team can match payments to usage?
2) We need UK VAT evidence (tax registration / supplier VAT certificate) to include with our AP release for the first tranche.

Also, please include bank remit details (beneficiary name, account, SWIFT/IBAN) and the invoice numbering convention so we can map to our PO.

Would appreciate a proposed phased invoice schedule and a single spreadsheet that shows expected drawdowns and dates. If you prefer, Ben/Finance can coordinate directly on wiring details.

Best,
Alex Shah
Director, Strategic Procurement
AtlasHealth

Subject: Re: Annual prepay — invoicing cadence & VAT routing

Alex — thanks for the clear asks. Proposal below and attached a draft schedule workbook (RDW_Phased_Invoice_Schedule.xlsx).

Proposed approach (high level):
- We will issue four invoices at these dates: 2027-07-01, 2027-10-01, 2028-01-01, 2028-04-01. Each invoice equals 25% of the committed prepay amount.
- Each invoice will include: invoice number (RDW-<deal>-YYYYMMNN), PO reference (please include your PO on the invoice), and a short line-item mapping to the committed product SKUs so your GL can match it.
- We will provide a shared drawdown tracker (sheet in the workbook) that shows the remaining balance after each invoice and an expected token/usage estimate for the period.

Finance notes / actions: Ben and Hannah — can you confirm remit details below and attach VAT evidence for AtlasHealth UK (we have a UK tax pack in the finance bucket).

Bank remit (draft — finance to confirm):
- Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Bank: First West Bank
- Account: 123456789
- SWIFT: FWBKUS33
- IBAN: US00FWBK123456789

Attached: RDW_Phased_Invoice_Schedule.xlsx (tabs: schedule, drawdown-tracker, sample-invoice)

Alex — once Finance confirms the remit fields and provides the UK VAT evidence, we can issue the first tranche invoice and attach the invoice to the DocuSign mutual action plan if needed.

Would you like the invoices emailed to procurements@atlashealth.com and copied to you?

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
